about_the_game:
Drug Empire is a casual simulator game where you grow, synthesize and distribute drugs to build your underground empire. Manage production, inventory, and distribution network while unlocking new ways to expand your operation!

Start with a basic grow room and expand your empire:

  • Grow better weed strains and cultivate magic mushrooms

  • Unlock a lab to synthesize different types of products

  • Manage a network of dealers across locations with varying daily demand

  • Unlock access to a black market with special items

Complete more than 100 different tasks, unlock access to a black market to get special seeds, rare lab recipes and materials.

Grow Plants

Grow multiple strains of weed with different yields and needs. Control the growing process by adjusting light and watering your plants. Expand by buying more planting slots, better seeds and finish tasks to obtain seeds of rare strains.

Cultivate Mushrooms

Unlock mushroom cultivation equipment and cultivate various kinds of magic mushrooms, each with their different environment requirements like humidity and temperature.

Synthesis Lab

Unlock a lab, discover new lab recipes, gather materials and create synthetic products that will put your underground empire on another level. Become a master of synthesis by overseeing and balancing the ratios and synthesis properties!

Manage Distribution

Hire dealers to boost your sales and assign them to locations with different product demand that dynamically changes everyday.

Black Market

Unlock access to a black market where you can trade your products in exchange for special strains, rare lab recipes and crafting materials.

Complete Tasks

Finish more than 100 different tasks to get extra cash and reputation, rare seeds, lab recipes or materials.

Disclaimer

This game contains fictional depictions of drug production and distribution. It is intended for entertainment purposes only. All names, characters, locations and events in the game are entirely fictional. The developer does not endorse, support, or encourage any illegal activities in real life. All content is intended for mature audiences and should be understood as purely fictional entertainment.
